data.message: I commit to 18 tons this month and invite each of the other 24 to opt in individually—not an all-or-nothing deal. If k choose 18 and others 10, catch=250+8k, remaining=250-8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500-16k (25%). Switching adds $8,000 now if fulfilled, but lowers the bad-outcome stock by 16 tons; long-run gains aren't guaranteed. Intentions aren't enforceable; other catches require recalculation. Please state your exact intended catch and any conditions.
